_about: The site's pages and its public address, in one place, because three readers need them:
the build (vite.config.ts writes each page's metadata and the crawl files from src/app/site/),
the page header (the cookie-settings button only appears on a page that carries the ad tag),
and tools/finish-web-build.mjs, which checks the built site against this file and cannot import
TypeScript. Every page listed here is built; a page not listed here fails the build.
origin: the site's canonical address, with no trailing slash. Canonical links, og:url, og:image,
robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt are the only places it is written out; asset paths stay
relative so the site still works from any subfolder (ADR 0004).
adScript: whether the page carries the AdSense tag. privacy.html does not: AdSense Help (answer
10961370) asks that the privacy page the consent message links to hosts no ad tags and no
consent-message tag. The google-adsense-account meta is not a script and goes on every page.
